nodes.label: Fault F31.2 — FINDING-RING's overbinding attribution is false for form R
Form R over-corrects with the bare second-order exchange constant
nodes.rationale: Form R = full RPA ring/2 + BARE E0B. Pure RPA overbinds the UEG, but adding the r_s-independent bare SOX constant (+0.0242 Ha) over-corrects at metallic r_s because the true screened SOX is smaller. Against recalled benchmarks both forms UNDERBIND at every r_s >= 1, so the 'ring's own overbinding' premise has the wrong sign and the downstream inference is withdrawn while the numbers stand.
